long_biography.plain_text:
Ferolito began as a Brooklyn beer and soda distributor, using an old van with Vultaggio to serve small shops. The partnership moved into branded malt liquor before launching AriZona Iced Tea in 1992. Its large, brightly packaged cans offered more tea at an accessible price, and the company rapidly became a leader in ready-to-drink beverages.

Relations between the founders later frayed, and Vultaggio assumed day-to-day control while both family groups retained equal economic interests. A court-supervised valuation led to a confidential buyout settlement in 2015, ending the Ferolito side's ownership. Ferolito subsequently returned to the market by launching and backing Saint James, an organic tea brand built around lower-sugar drinks and more sustainable packaging.
